through: 2025-26 regular season (final). 'recent' = each player's last 10 games played in 2025-26 (from basketball-reference game logs). No 2026-27 games played yet - season opens Oct 20, 2026. Teams, injuries and news updated through Oct 19, 2026 (evening ET).
scoring: Standard points per game from 2025-26 per-game box averages: PTS + 1.2*REB + 1.5*AST + 3*STL + 3*BLK - TOV
notes: Refresh Oct 19, 2026: basketball-reference.com was reachable this run. 'recent' now = average over each player's last 10 games played in the 2025-26 regular season, computed from basketball-reference game logs (players/<id>/gamelog/2026) with this file's scoring formula. Players whose last 10 games ended before April 2026 (missed the end of the season) carry a flag giving the window.

Season values were checked against the basketball-reference 2025-26 per-game table: all stored values agree within 0.25 except Derik Queen (stored value was a 32-game snapshot; replaced with the full 81-game line). Victor Wembanyama and Zach LaVine, previously omitted for missing turnovers, now have season/recent from basketball-reference. Earlier source-conflict flags confirmed by basketball-reference were resolved. No other season numbers changed.

team = 2026-27 team, verified for every player against ESPN team roster pages fetched Oct 19, 2026 (all 137 matched; Cam Johnson appears as Cameron Johnson). Russell Westbrook and Cam Thomas appear on no ESPN roster and remain excluded.

Health from the ESPN injury page (Rotowire data, comments through Oct 19), the CBS Sports injury report (updated Oct 19) and the FantasyPros news feed (Oct 7-19), plus WebSearch summaries for returners. Players previously marked 'minor' who no longer appear on either injury report were moved to 'healthy' with a flag saying so; that is absence from a report, not an explicit all-clear.

Not reachable: stats.nba.com returned an empty reply (site refuses non-browser clients; not worked around). landofbasketball.com and basketball.realgm.com returned 403. No opening-night starting lineups had been announced in the sources checked, so role changes are limited to reported outlooks.

Data gathered via web search summaries of Land of Basketball, RealGM, Stat Sniper, StatMuse, StatsCrew, TeamRankings, ESPN and others; basketball-reference/ESPN stats pages could not be fetched directly (WebFetch DNS failure).
pos = one primary position assigned from standard listings (not read per player from a source).

health/role marked from reported news only; day-to-day items (minor) mostly come from the FantasyPros feed of Oct 5-17 and may be stale by opening night. Injury items where the source gave no timeline carry a flag saying the tier is a guess.

Previously excluded players: DeMar DeRozan (now added: DEN) and Kristaps Porzingis (now added: GSW, out indefinitely). Still excluded: Russell Westbrook (FantasyPros lists him FA/retired after an announced retirement about 9 weeks before Oct 17; other outlets still describe him as unsigned, so unresolved) and Cam Thomas (free agent; Bucks waived him around March 2026, no 2026-27 team found).
sources: https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/ (gamelog/2026 page for each of 133 players, e.g. https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/j/jokicni01/gamelog/2026)
